Overview

Kenitra is a city in Rabat-Salé-Kénitra with a population of 431,000. An industrial port city on the Sebou River, known for its growing manufacturing sector and proximity to Rabat. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
